def apply_format_to_elements(string, list_):
    return [string.format(i) for i in list_]


# Example usage / self-test
if __name__ == "__main__":
    result = apply_format_to_elements("{:.2f}", [1.234, 5.678, 9.012])
    assert result == ["1.23", "5.68", "9.01"]
    assert apply_format_to_elements("{}", ["temp1", "temp2", "temp3", "temp4"])[-1] == "temp4"
    print(result)
